title: fix(release): pass --tag on workflow_dispatch in release-desktop.yml and use pwsh on Windows (blocks desktop-v0.3.4/v0.3.5 & leaves main red)
body:
## Problem

The consolidated desktop release workflow (`.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml`) currently fails whenever triggered via `workflow_dispatch` on `main`, which:

1. **Leaves `main` (`d8b4a95`) showing failed check runs (`Linux x64` and `Windows x64`)** from [`Desktop release #5`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40490521106).
2. **Blocks backfilling missing GitHub Releases for `desktop-v0.3.4` (`87ef47f`) and `desktop-v0.3.5` (`fddab5c`)**, neither of which currently has a published GitHub Release (`desktop-v0.3.3` jumps straight to `desktop-v0.3.6`).

### Root cause 1 — Unconditional `prepare-release-assets.mjs` step without `--tag` breaks every `workflow_dispatch`

In `.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml` (`linux` lines 109–111 and `windows` lines 169–171), `prepare-release-assets.mjs` is invoked **twice** — first unconditionally without `--tag`, and only second conditionally with `--tag`:

```yaml
      - run: node apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-release-assets.mjs --dist .staging/app/dist
      - if: startsWith(needs.gate.outputs.ref, 'desktop-')
        run: node apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-release-assets.mjs --dist .staging/app/dist --tag "${{ needs.gate.outputs.ref }}"
```

Inside `apps/desktop/scripts/prepare-release-assets.mjs` (`lines 23–26, 46–50`):

```js
function parseDesktopVersion(input) {
  const match = /^desktop-v(\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)$/.exec(input.trim())
  return match ? match[1] : input
}

function main() {
  const tag = argumentValue('--tag') ?? process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME ?? ''
  const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
  const version = tag ? parseDesktopVersion(tag) : (argumentValue('--version') ?? manifest.version)
```

- On a tag `push` (`desktop-v0.3.6`), `GITHUB_REF_NAME` is `"desktop-v0.3.6"`, so `parseDesktopVersion` extracts `"0.3.6"` and step 1 succeeds (running step 2 redundantly afterward).
- On a `workflow_dispatch` run on `main` (e.g. [`Desktop release #4`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40490081317) and [`Desktop release #5`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40490521106)), GitHub sets `GITHUB_REF_NAME="main"`. Step 1 runs without `--tag`, resolves `version = "main"`, searches `.staging/app/dist` for `Greeneek-Desktop-main-linux-amd64.deb` / `Greeneek-Desktop-main-windows-x64.exe`, and crashes with `Error: Missing release assets` before the `--tag` step ever executes.

### Root cause 2 — `shell: bash` inside the `windows-2025` job violates `.github/AGENTS.md`

`.github/AGENTS.md` explicitly mandates:

> *Run Windows steps under native `pwsh`, never Bash, so packaged binaries see the real Win32 environment (`PATHEXT`, `.cmd` shims, backslash paths).*

However, `.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml` still declares `shell: bash` in two `windows` (`runs-on: windows-2025`) steps:
- `Stage the desktop app when the tag tree does not` (`lines 153–158`)
- `Assert updater channel files` (`lines 163–168`)

### Historical release check debt across `desktop-v0.2.*` and `desktop-v0.3.*`

Across the current `Desktop release` workflow and the retired two-workflow split (`desktop.yml` + `desktop-windows.yml`), **27 failed runs** and **5 cancelled runs** occurred:
- **`desktop-v0.3.4` (`87ef47f`) & `desktop-v0.3.5` (`fddab5c`)**: still have **no GitHub Release** (`#24` failed pre-stage packaging; `#1` tag run on `desktop-v0.3.5` was cancelled; dispatches `#2`, `#4`, `#5` failed).
- **`desktop-v0.2.0` (`c0755d4`)**: published GitHub Release has **0 assets** (`assets: []`).
- **`desktop-v0.2.1` (`b796ec0`)**: **no GitHub Release** (`Linux x64` updater channel check failed in `#9`; `Windows x64` `#9` cancelled).
- **`desktop-v0.2.2`–`desktop-v0.2.4`**: Linux-only partial releases (`Windows x64` failed `dist:win` in `#10`–`#12`, which motivated the unified single-publisher `release-desktop.yml`).
- **`desktop-v0.2.5`**: published release still contains a stray `builder-debug.yml` diagnostic artifact.

`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `0.87.1` introduces breaking TypeScript contract changes across provider compatibility flags, thinking capability keys, API identifiers, JSON argument types, and transcript replay structures that `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` exhaustively type-checks.

title: fix(deps): group lockstep package families in dependabot.yml to prevent split-version typecheck failures (failing CI #185 on PR #89)
body:
## Problem

`.github/dependabot.yml` currently configures `npm`, `uv`, and `github-actions` updates **without `groups:` rules** for lockstep monorepo families (`lexical` + `@lexical/*`, `tailwindcss` + `@tailwindcss/*`, `@opentelemetry/*`, `vite` + `@vitejs/*`) and references two non-existent labels (`kind/dependency` and `area/infra`, whereas the repository's actual label set uses `dependencies` and `build`).

As a direct result, **open PR #89** (`chore(deps-dev): bump @lexical/headless from 0.49.0 to 0.51.0`, branch `dependabot/npm_and_yarn/lexical/headless-0.51.0` @ `e62750c`) is currently failing **All checks have failed** in [`CI #185`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40128565672) (`ci (22)` → `Run pnpm typecheck`).

### Exact `pnpm typecheck` failure on Open PR #89 (`CI #185`)

Because Dependabot bumped `@lexical/headless` (`0.49.0 → 0.51.0`) alone while `lexical` and `@lexical/react` stayed at `0.49.0`, pnpm resolves two distinct `LexicalEditor` / `LexicalNodeConfig` nominal class instances in `.pnpm`:

- `packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/lexical-editor-core.client.spec.tsx:45`:
  ```text
  Type 'import(".../node_modules/.pnpm/lexical@0.51.0_typescript@6.0.3/node_modules/lexical/dist/LexicalEditor").LexicalEditor'
  is not assignable to type
  'import(".../node_modules/.pnpm/lexical@0.49.0_typescript@6.0.3/node_modules/lexical/dist/LexicalEditor").LexicalEditor'.
  ```
- `packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/lexical-editor-core.client.spec.tsx:47`:
  ```text
  Type 'typeof ReferenceChipNode' is not assignable to type 'LexicalNodeConfig'.
  Type 'typeof TextRefNode' is not assignable to type 'LexicalNodeConfig'.
  ```

### Related Dependabot package-family & major-upgrade CI failures

The same ungrouped / major-bump configuration previously caused 8 additional Dependabot PR `CI` failures:

title: fix(ci): remove duplicate pnpm version pin in workflows and upgrade Node 20 actions (CI #5..#38, #41 & Dependabot #2, #5, #22, #34, #94)
body:
## Problem

This issue tracks three closely related CI / workflow-infrastructure check failures (**40 failed workflow runs + 1 cancelled dynamic run**), including [`CI #5` — **Import rebranded DeepSeek Harness**](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/33712871035) (PR #11) and two **still-live hazards** in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and `.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml` on `main` (`d8b4a95`).

### 1. Live latent bug: duplicate `pnpm` version pin in workflows (`CI #5`–`#38`, 34 failed runs)

In [`CI #5` (`Import rebranded DeepSeek Harness`)](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/33712871035) through [`CI #38`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/33951262149) (34 consecutive pushes and PRs), `pnpm/action-setup` failed immediately at step 3 with:

```text
Error: Multiple versions of pnpm specified:
  - version 9.15.4 in the GitHub Action config with the key "version"
  - version pnpm@11.7.0 in the package.json with the key "packageManager"
Remove one of these versions to avoid version mismatch errors like ERR_PNPM_BAD_PM_VERSION
```

Instead of removing `with: version:` from the workflow as `pnpm/action-setup` instructs, the earlier fix bumped the workflow YAML literal to `version: 11.7.0`. **Both `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`line 22`) and `.github/workflows/release-desktop.yml` (`lines 78, 139`) still hardcode `version: 11.7.0` alongside `"packageManager": "pnpm@11.7.0"` in `package.json` today.** Consequently:
- Every Dependabot `pnpm` update (e.g. PR #40 `bump pnpm from 11.7.0 to 11.21.0`) or the planned `#64` upgrade (`pnpm 11.28.5` in #86) that updates `package.json#packageManager` will immediately fail `pnpm/action-setup` again unless `with: version:` is removed from both workflows.
- [`CI #41`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/33982376196) subsequently failed at `Run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` while reconciling the lockfile transition.

### 2. Live warning on every workflow run: deprecated Node 20 GitHub Actions

Every single job in `CI` and `Desktop release` currently emits GitHub's runner warning:

```text
Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24:
actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, pnpm/action-setup@v4.
```

title: fix(test-support): migrate remaining session-snapshot vi.waitFor log pollers to waitForPersistedRecord (CI #188, #209 + 52 test-lane CI runs)

## Problem

Across `CI` (`Run pnpm test -- --coverage --reporter=verbose`), **54 failed workflow runs** (plus 1 cancelled run `CI #101`) stem from timing-sensitive subprocess/shell/UI tests under V8 coverage instrumentation and snapshot/preset harness assertions — and **one latent `vi.waitFor` timeout-masking bug still remains on `main` (`d8b4a95`) today**.

### Live latent bug on `main` (`d8b4a95`): remaining `vi.waitFor` pollers in `packages/test-support/session-snapshot/src/harness.ts`

In [`CI #209`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40254789718) (on a pure docs commit `65ec3f0`, `docs(notes): speak the rebrand contract in the release notes`) and [`CI #188`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40138319290), `packages/test-support/session-snapshot/tests/harness.spec.ts` failed under runner load because `harvestSessionLogs(root)` took longer than a short timeout budget (`20ms`), causing `vi.waitFor` to discard the callback's diagnostic error and throw generic `Timed out in waitFor!`.

Commits `63f512f7` and `154c3e8e` fixed `waitForPersistedTitleAfterTurnEnd`, `waitForPersistedEventAfterTurnEnd` (via `waitForPersistedRecord` at `harness.ts:694`), and `waitForPersistedTurnEnd` (`harness.ts:576`). **However, three sibling async log-harvesting helpers in `packages/test-support/session-snapshot/src/harness.ts` still use raw `vi.waitFor` without `waitForPersistedRecord` or `.catch(() => { throw budgetError })`**:

1. `waitForPersistedChildTurnEnd` (`packages/test-support/session-snapshot/src/harness.ts:606–621`)
2. `waitForPersistedGoalPhase` (`packages/test-support/session-snapshot/src/harness.ts:632–648`)
3. `waitForPersistedInboxMessage` (`packages/test-support/session-snapshot/src/harness.ts:651–672`)

In addition, `packages/test-support/session-snapshot/tests/harness.spec.ts:70` sets:
```ts
const titleDiagnosticTimeoutMs = process.platform === 'win32' ? 5_000 : 20
```
While `waitForPersistedRecord` guarantees at least one completed poll before checking `Date.now() >= deadline`, migrating the three remaining `vi.waitFor` pollers onto `waitForPersistedRecord` eliminates the exact same class of load-induced `Timed out in waitFor!` failure before it hits `CI` again.

### Summary of all 54 test-lane failures covered by this audit

- **`packages/client/ui-agent-preset/tests/components.client.spec.tsx` (21 runs: `#87`, `#90`–`#107`, `#127`)** — `disables every pill while a switch is in flight` / `stages the picked preset on click` / `falls back to the id`.
- **`packages/terminal/terminal-bash/tests/local.spec.ts` (10 runs: `#129`, `#131`–`#139`)** — `terminal-bash pwsh real shell > bootstraps a persistent pwsh, persists state, and scrubs secrets` (real `pwsh` startup budget under coverage).
- **`scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts` (9 runs: `#57`, `#59`–`#66`)** — `refuses dormant repository extensions before upgrading the repository format` (also broke 4 unrelated Dependabot PRs `#59`–`#62`).
- **`CI #1`–`#4` (`ci (20)`) & `#44`–`#46` (`ci (22)`) (7 runs)** — initial Node 20 / post-rebrand test suite stabilization runs.
- **`packages/preset/agent-presets/tests/shipped-root.spec.ts` (3 runs: `#196`–`#198`; `#195` also tripped `cordis-catalog.spec.ts`)** — preset roster & `web_fetch` invariants during v0.3.4 preset work.
- **`packages/test-support/session-snapshot/tests/harness.spec.ts` (2 runs: `#188`, `#209`)** — `waitForEventAfterTurnEnd` and `waitForTurnEnd` deadline/message races under coverage load.
- **`scripts/verify-source-plane.spec.ts` (2 runs: `#205`, `#206`)** — `scans the real tree without emitted output`.
- **Single-run test regressions (3 runs)**: `#43` (`scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts`), `#76` (`scripts/project-doc-site.spec.ts`), `#144` (`packages/client/ui-theme/tests/elevation-styles.client.spec.ts`).

title: chore(ci): share Brand sweep & full lint gates between ci.yml and lefthook.yml to stop main hygiene breakages (47 failed CI runs)
body:
## Problem

**47 failed `CI` runs** failed in static hygiene gates — **`Brand sweep` (12 runs)**, **`Secret scan (gitleaks)` (3 runs)**, and **`Run pnpm lint` (32 general lint runs + 5 `PageEntry[]`/`DocsPage[]` runs = 37 runs; 5 Dependabot package-upgrade lint runs are tracked in the Dependabot grouping issue, leaving 47 runs here)** — primarily because **key CI gates in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` are absent from local Git hooks (`lefthook.yml`) and `main` has no required status-check ruleset**.

### Concrete local-vs-CI gate gaps on `main` (`d8b4a95`)

1. **`Brand sweep` exists only inline in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`lines 32–44`), not in `scripts/` or `lefthook.yml`**:
   ```yaml
   - name: Brand sweep
     run: |
       hits=$(git grep -niE 'deepseek|\bdsh\b' -- \
         ':!THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md' \
         ':!README.md' \
         ':!vendor/**' \
         ':!pnpm-lock.yaml' \
         ':!.github/workflows/ci.yml' || true)
   ```
   Because `lefthook.yml` never runs this check locally (neither on staged files in `pre-commit` nor in `pre-push`), commits touching `.agents/notes/` or docs repeatedly passed local hooks (`lint`, `typecheck`) and then failed `Brand sweep` on `main` — including **8 runs in the last few days alone** (`CI #199`–`#204`, `#207`, `#208`, plus `#42`, `#45`, `#46`, `#47`).
2. **Staged `.oxlintrc.staged.json` vs full `pnpm lint` gap**:
   - `lefthook.yml` runs `scripts/run-oxlint.ts --config .oxlintrc.staged.json` only on `*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,mjs}` in `pre-commit` and runs `pnpm run typecheck` in `pre-push`, whereas CI runs full `pnpm lint` (including repo-wide lint/doc/type-aware rules). As recently as [`CI #214`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40381758691) and [`CI #215`](https://github.com/Mostafa-Taher-git/Greeneek/actions/runs/40381940788), pushes to `main` failed `Run pnpm lint`.
3. **`Secret scan (gitleaks)` (`CI #128`, `#130`, `#134`)**:
   - Triggered across both `main` (`#128`, `#134`) and unrelated Dependabot PR `#46` (`#130`) when `fetch-depth: 0` history contained flagged high-entropy/fixture tokens prior to cleanup.

title: chore(landing): scope Vercel builds to apps/landing changes and verify landing build in CI (10 failed Vercel status checks)
body:
## Problem

In addition to GitHub Actions check runs, the repository has a connected **Vercel** Git integration (`mostafa-web/landing`) that posts commit status checks (`context: "Vercel"`) and `Vercel Preview Comments` check runs on **every push and every pull request across the entire monorepo** — even when `apps/landing` is completely untouched (such as Python SDK, GitHub Actions, and root npm Dependabot PRs).

Inspecting commit statuses across all 270 `main` commits and 65 pull requests uncovered **10 failed `Vercel` deployment checks** (`state: "failure"`):
- **6 failed production/branch deployments on `main`** during landing-page iteration (`a4b5124` → `f49d2db`).
- **4 failed preview deployments on unrelated root Dependabot PRs** (`PR #37`, `PR #38`, `PR #40`, `PR #41`), because those PRs branched from `main` while `apps/landing` had a failing Vercel build and `apps/landing/vercel.json` had no `ignoreCommand` to skip unrelated commits!

### Current `apps/landing/vercel.json`

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://openapi.vercel.sh/vercel.json",
  "buildCommand": "npm run build",
  "outputDirectory": "dist",
  "framework": "vite"
}
```

Furthermore, `apps/landing` is currently **not built or type-checked in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`**, so landing-app build regressions are only discovered post-push by external Vercel builds rather than by repository CI.

- [ ] Add an `ignoreCommand` to `apps/landing/vercel.json` (e.g. `git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .`) so Vercel skips builds on PRs and commits that do not modify `apps/landing/`.
- [ ] Add an `apps/landing` build/typecheck verification step to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (or workspace build script) so landing-page build errors are caught deterministically in repository CI before reaching Vercel.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Unrelated PRs (e.g. `.github/workflows/*`, `python/sdk/*`, or core `packages/*` changes) skip unnecessary Vercel rebuilds instead of failing on unrelated landing state.
- [ ] `apps/landing` `tsc` + `vite build` are verified in `CI` whenever `apps/landing/**` changes.
